ui.help: Requests executed without Provisioned Concurrency. Free Tier is intentionally not subtracted by this calculator.
Average billed execution duration for on-demand invocations in milliseconds.
Configured function memory. The same function configuration is used for on-demand, Provisioned Concurrency, and SnapStart pricing.

selectors.label: Additional ephemeral storage above included 512 MB

ui.help: Lambda includes 512 MB at no additional charge. Enter the additional configured storage above 512 MB; maximum total ephemeral storage is 10,240 MB. SnapStart is available only when this value is 0.
Number of pre-initialized execution environments configured for Provisioned Concurrency. SnapStart and Provisioned Concurrency cannot be enabled on the same function version.

Total billed time that Provisioned Concurrency is enabled during the month. AWS bills each enabled period with five-minute rounding; enter the resulting aggregate billed hours when schedules are fragmented.
Requests handled while Provisioned Concurrency is enabled. Spillover requests should be included in the on-demand request inputs instead.
Average billed duration for requests executed with Provisioned Concurrency.

Use java-managed-no-charge for supported Java managed runtimes. Use billable-runtime for SnapStart configurations subject to cache and restore pricing. SnapStart cannot be combined with Provisioned Concurrency or ephemeral storage above 512 MB.
Sum billed cache time across active published SnapStart versions. AWS bills each version for at least three hours and then per millisecond while active.
Number of execution-environment restores from the cached snapshot during the month.
